description: Unicode text inspector — Inspect any string at the code-point level: per-character code point (U+XXXX), UTF-8 bytes, UTF-16 units, general category and script, plus totals (code points, UTF-16 units, UTF-8 bytes, graphemes, words, lines), script and category mix, NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD equality and forms, URL-encoded form and a security verdict CLEAN/REVIEW/SUSPICIOUS. Flags invisible tag characters (and decodes ASCII smuggled in them - a prompt-injection trick), bidi overrides (Trojan Source), zero-width characters (emoji ZWJ sequences are exempt), unusual spaces, controls, private-use, unassigned and noncharacters, and mixed-script words (homograph spoofing). Params: text= (max 5000 UTF-16 units) OR codepoints= (U+1F600, 0x41, A, A lists); max_chars= rows in the per-character table (default 300, max 1000). Offline. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: text_unicode
